title: Take a teacher off a class, or move them

handbook.what: Changing which classes a teacher takes without removing them from the school. The ticks start from what is true today, so moving somebody from one class to another is a single change rather than two.
handbook.where: The **Teachers** page, **Assign to a class** on that teacher's row, then the ticks.
how: Open **Assign to a class** on the teacher's row.
Untick the class they are leaving.
Tick the class they are joining, if there is one.
Tap **Save** — the button counts your changes back to you before you commit.
handbook.note: If part of a change fails the panel stays open and names the class it could not do, and the ticks reset to what is actually true. Nothing is ever reported as saved when it was not.
